Lauren / Vivek,

Looping you in. Bluewave is holding payment citing two issues: (1) VAT posted incorrectly for an EU entity, and (2) invoice date/description implies recognition in Jan 2026 while the services were for December usage and our sales contract notes Dec-2025 delivery. Finance flagged this as a potential period-shift that will impact Q4/2025 revenue if we correct it — need a journal correction and a credit/reissue if needed.

Attachments: BW-INV-2043.pdf (invoice), BW-REM-2043.pdf (remittance).

Ask: can Finance confirm whether we can: 1) apply a credit memo and reissue a corrected invoice to Bluewave (EU tax code change), and 2) post a journal to move the revenue recognition to Dec-2025 so audits don't show a timing gap? If approvals/steps are needed, advise and I'll coordinate with the customer.

— Ben

Ben —

Thanks for the heads up and attachments. Quick notes:

- We can do a correcting credit memo + reissue, but we need the customer's short explanation of why the tax jurisdiction is different (EU branch vs. non-EU billing). Please confirm the bill-to party.
- For the revenue period shift: we'll need a journal entry that reverses the Jan posting and posts revenue to Dec-2025, plus a memo explaining why (customer-confirmed delivery date). That will affect Q1 2026 revenue by the same amount.
- Routing: I need manager sign-off (Vivek) for any journal older than the current period. Also need PO reference (they included it in the remittance; I need the PO number in text).

If you can get Bluewave to confirm the bill-to and accept a credit/reissue, we'll prepare JRNL-2043-CORR for approval. I'll flag as high priority — auditors are spot-checking enterprise deals this quarter.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Accountant, Redwood Inference

All —

I drafted a proposed correction workflow and a journal stub. Summary:

1) Issue credit memo BW-INV-2043-CREDIT for the full invoice amount to clear the AR balance.
2) Reissue corrected invoice BW-INV-2043 (tax code updated to EU-VAT and bill-to set to Bluewave Systems EMEA).
3) Post JRNL-2043-CORR:
   - Debit: Revenue (to reverse Jan posting) — amount 372,450.00 USD equivalent
   - Credit: Deferred Revenue / AR (to reallocate) — amount 372,450.00 USD equivalent
   - Post date: 2025-12-31 (to reflect delivery month)

Notes: manager approval required for backdating to FY25; impact will reduce Q1/2026 revenue and increase Q4/2025. Tax team needs to confirm VAT reclaimability once we re-bill to the EMEA entity.

I've attached JRNL-2043-CORR.csv for review. If Lauren signs off, I can route for manager approval and then Ben can deliver the corrected invoice/credit memo to the customer.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
